ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.document_title: Anna University - Affiliated Institutions - Regulations 2017 - Choice Based Credit System - Common to all B.E. / B.Tech. Full-Time Programmes
ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.locate_phrase: not less than 50% of total marks
ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.passing_criteria: A candidate must secure not less than 50% of the total marks prescribed for the course (Internal Assessment + End Semester University Examinations). The candidate must also secure a minimum of 45% of the marks prescribed for the End-Semester University Examination; this applies to both theory and practical courses, including project work.

UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.regulation: University of Delhi Ordinance IX, Article 157: Passing/Promotion Criteria and eligibility for the award of Degree for the Honors and Programme Courses under the Three Year Semester-Scheme
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.clause_heading: 157 Passing/Promotion Criteria and eligibility for the award of Degree for the Honors and Programme Courses under the Three Year Semester-Scheme
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.locate_phrase: A student who has obtained 40% in the aggregate
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.passing_criteria: A student must obtain 40% in the aggregate, taking together all papers in theory examination (including internal assessment/project work) and practical examinations separately, up to the end of the sixth semester to be awarded the degree. For promotion, 40% in the aggregate applies for the first and second years, and 50% of papers of the relevant semesters must be passed for year-to-year promotion.
